name: Stairway to Nowhere
description: A stone staircase rises above a heather moor and ends in midair.

scenes.name: Lower Steps
scenes.description: The same unfamiliar constellation is carved into every step.

scenes.name: Upper Landing
scenes.description: The shadow of a door lies on the last step, although there is no door.

scenes.name: View from Above
scenes.description: From this height, the moor looks like a map of a country found in no atlas.
